title: LoveSick
lyrics:
[00:02.31]Hey, I heard you're doing better, never knew you as a quitter
[00:04.99]And I'm glad you're doing okay
[00:06.51]I don't know if you remember all the times you wrote me letters
[00:08.63]And I think you took me out in fifth grade
[00:11.07]And I think I told you no, I said I wanna take it slow
[00:12.95]And I also called you gross to your face
[00:15.12]But I think everybody knows it was just a funny joke
[00:17.33]So, do you wanna go on that date?
[00:21.08]I've been feeling quite amazing flying kites with you
[00:24.79]Rephrasing words from songs that I wrote myself
[00:28.60]It ain't good for my health
[00:29.93]But I spend nights thinkin' of you, I write you songs when I miss you
[00:34.37]I promise I'll be there to help, though I might need a ride
[00:40.86]You keep catchin' my eyes
[00:44.99]You're here when I'm terrified
[00:49.22]Can't get you off of my mind
[00:54.98]Oh, I've been feeling faded 'cause I'm fiending on the Hennessy
[00:59.48]Tell everyone I made it, though I'm miles from where I want to be
[01:03.66]I told my story countless times to all these fucking companies
[01:07.93]I used to be a worthless piece of shit, a boy with issues, see
[01:12.23]I've changed throughout this year so much, the "Who" I was, you won't believe
[01:16.44]Obsessed with being normal, faking cordial actions, fantasies
[01:20.88]Situations playing out so perfect like the movie scenes
[01:24.95]I want to take my mask off, but I'm scared because I'll never be enough for me
[01:36.09]I think I'm losing grip on sanity
[01:46.18]Oh, I've been feeling quite amazing flying kites with you
[01:50.13]Rephrasing words from songs that I wrote myself
[01:53.96]It ain't good for my health
[01:55.40]But I spend nights thinkin' of you, I write you songs when I miss you
[01:59.67]I promise I'll be there to help, though I might need a ride
[02:06.28]You keep catchin' my eyes
[02:10.21]You're here when I'm terrified
[02:14.48]Can't get you off of my mind
